Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity across regime changes (IFRS 17/LDTI). The machinery deciding those outcomes is data and document heavy — ideal ground for governed automation.

items: Lapse and mortality experience signals arrive late; retention and repricing actions lag.
APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.

blocks.x: The pattern composes RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems, Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems, AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Underwriting evidence assembly, Policy servicing transactions, Claims/beneficiary processing) on Achala Compass and Achala Forge and Achala Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — IFRS 17 / LDTI among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Replace hype with evidence — feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks.
Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products — retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
